name: Kkalpana Industries (India) Limited
about: Kkalpana Industries (India) Limited manufactures and sells plastic compounds in India and internationally. It offers polyethylene, polyethylene terephthalate, polypropylene, polyvinyl chloride, and polystyrene. The company also provides reprocessed granules, scraps, and others compounds. It serves cable, piping, packaging, and footwear sectors. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in South 24 Parganas, India. Kkalpana Industries (India) Limited is a subsidiary of Bbigplas Poly Private Limited.
